_rangeDisplayModeHelp: Always shows property and Base Defense ranges. HoldHotkey shows them only while the configured hotkey is held. Legacy HoldShift is also accepted. Max Sockets is unaffected.
_holdToDisplayHotkeyHelp: Key held to show ranges in HoldHotkey mode. Accepts Shift, LeftShift, RightShift, Ctrl, LeftCtrl, RightCtrl, Alt, LeftAlt, RightAlt, A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, Mouse4, or Mouse5.
_propertyRangeColorHelp: ChronicleColor uses the default Chronicle teal/light blue color. BHDarkGreen uses BH's dark green color (the one that came with the first iterations of this plugin).
